lines.zh: 快给我点吃的，不然别想活！
lines.en: Give me food or you die!
Don't be afraid, give me food.
Give the bones something to do!

lines.zh: 他贴着墙根走，手里攥着刀。
lines.en: He walks along the wall, knife in hand.

lines.zh: 他一步一停，听着巷子里的响动。
lines.en: He stops at every step to listen down the alley.

lines.zh: 我靠着断墙守夜，别出声。
lines.en: I keep watch against the broken wall; stay quiet.
Come, I have something for you!
Look at me, give me something!

lines.zh: 过来帮我，我有东西给你！
lines.en: Come help me, I have something for you!

lines.zh: 伤口发黑，已经救不了了。
lines.en: The wound is blackening. Too late for me.
Don't go; I just need to hold the wound.
Leave me, just watch the door.

lines.zh: 这里安全，可以吃点东西了。

lines.en: Get away, this is my turf!

lines.zh: 别贴过来，我身上有跳蚤。
lines.en: Don't press close; I'm covered in fleas.

lines.zh: 这条街我扫过了，往那边走。
lines.en: I cleared this street; go that way.

lines.zh: 你守前半夜，我守后半夜。
lines.en: You take the first watch; I'll take the second.
Stay with me, you won't be alone.

lines.zh: 拿起我的剑，别让我失望！
lines.en: Take my sword, don't disappoint me!

lines.zh: 别碰我的食物，那是我的！
lines.en: Don't touch my food, it's mine!
You're not worthy to eat my flesh!
My territory, you can't get close!

lines.zh: 跟我交易，否则你会后悔！
lines.en: Trade with me or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 我的刀刃很锋利，尝尝吧！
lines.en: My blade is sharp, taste it!

lines.zh: 手松开，我的砍刀在腰后。
lines.en: Let go; my machete is behind my hip.
Don't forget I was human once!

lines.zh: 末世里，先动手的才活着。
lines.en: In this wasteland, whoever strikes first lives.
Watch out, I'm not just a zombie!
I count to three, and your retreat is gone.

lines.zh: 你的命运掌握在我手中！
lines.en: Your fate is in my hands!

lines.zh: 这片街区，我只信我自己。
lines.en: In this block, I trust only myself.

lines.zh: 这条巷子只有一头出口。
lines.en: This alley has only one way out.

lines.zh: 你身上没有咬痕，我信你一次。
lines.en: No bite marks on you. I will trust you once.
Stop there and show me your hands.
Something is following you, isn't it?
Don't come closer. Tell me who you are first.

lines.zh: 你也是从废墟里爬出来的？
lines.en: Did you crawl out of the ruins too?

lines.zh: 活下来的人，都学会了狠。
lines.en: Anyone who survived learned to be cruel.
I crouch low, machete along my calf.
My knife has no sheath. That is how it is.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是为了挥得开。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to swing freely.
I have counted how many rounds are left.
I don't pick fights I can't win.
I put my back against the wall.
You move, and I move first.
Slow breathing, first I count heads.

lines.zh: 这双手杀过的东西比你多。
lines.en: These hands have killed more than you have.
Stay three blocks back; my blade is quick.
Get away or I'll bite you!

lines.zh: 这一撬棍，是给自己留的活路。
lines.en: This pry bar is my one way out alive.
You want to taste my teeth?

lines.zh: 我还想活着走出这片街区。
lines.en: I still want to walk out of this block alive.
Zombies everywhere and you rob me?
The knife goes in, and I pull back at once.
I drive my elbow into its jaw.
I slam a plank into its face.
I kick its knee to bring it down.

lines.zh: 我补了一刀，确保它不动。
lines.en: One more stab to be sure it stays down.

lines.zh: 废墟里有人影，我压低声音。
lines.en: A figure in the ruins; I lower my voice.

lines.zh: 瞭望塔上看见人影，我下来了。
lines.en: I spotted a figure from the watchtower and came down.
This corner — I can hold the door.

lines.zh: 废墟里有人掀开铁皮走出来。
lines.en: Someone lifts a sheet of tin and climbs out.

lines.zh: 他守着那堆火，等你开口。
lines.en: He guards a small fire, waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 一扇门开了，里面站着他。
lines.en: A door opens, and he is standing inside.

lines.zh: 他是这片废墟里第一个人。
lines.en: He is the first living person in these ruins.
I missed my footing on that wall.

lines.zh: 弩箭擦过肋骨，我弯下腰。
lines.en: A crossbow bolt grazes my ribs; I double over.
